The ships are far apart. The scene is primarily a pursuit.
f1e99101180f121bfc0b: A successful movement manoeuvre normally allows the distance to change by one band.
4430e800b2a5f0becc40: An approaching ship can move from In Sight to Under Fire.
f9918b660f875008751d: An escaping ship can move from Under Fire to In Sight.
faeeed223098f6842618: The manoeuvre does not automatically allow several bands to be crossed in the same turn.
5578e19e065a8326bd26: A Talent or Module can modify this limit when expressly specified.
84e8c0cb4748552da378: When one ship tries to escape and the other wants to prevent it, both make an opposed Check:
5e127ae2269b0ed1108f: The escaping ship uses its Helmsman. The pursuing ship uses its Helmsman to maintain contact.
4c31ea0d2908a2ccd169: The highest result determines who manages to impose their manoeuvre.
f866bd0201027621ea80: Escape is prevented; distance does not increase.
80a2f76c76cbb8978a90: The ships remain in the current band.
cbb35c64abf8b5ff3b2e: This procedure makes the resolution of opposed manoeuvres explicit, which previously had no dedicated formula.
6ee7eab5f9a5d0541443: If Escape fails, the pursuing ship gains the cannon shot of opportunity specified by the manoeuvre.
1a82477814f5ee35a179: The cannon shot can be made only if the enemy ship is within a distance reachable by Artillery.
0a0a1b9cae224915cce8: The cannon shot of opportunity does not automatically allow a ship already out of reach to be hit.
31712ef40d8470f7d5a7: Reaching the On the Horizon band does not necessarily end pursuit: the two ships could still see each other.
722f23045540931b3926: The GM determines when contact is permanently lost, considering visibility, sea conditions, navigation instruments and actual possibilities of continuing.
4e1085669153b527c936: No fixed number of rounds is required to disappear over the horizon.
098a320a254397917338: An immobilised ship cannot gain distance through a normal Escape manoeuvre. If the Engine Room is destroyed or other damage prevents active movement, the crew must first solve that problem or exploit an ability that expressly allows movement.
c4434c5ff9b21a354ec3: When the ship reaches 0 Structure Points, it enters the Sunk state.
cd83f4e09d77ce4c2c6b: It can no longer continue normal navigation or combat.
